verdict.rationale: Stablecoin settlement is a fair question for an agentic payments product, so the axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence pack mentions stablecoins, crypto, or on-chain rails. The documented agent payment paths settle through Braintree delegated tokens (ACP), Google Pay tokens via Braintree (UCP), and standard PayPal Orders v2, and Store Sync is limited to USD.

support.subject: As a developer, I can settle agent-initiated payments in stablecoins over documented rails
